user: On account ACC-1011, settled TX-1002, GBP 26,000 Supplier invoice 2214, was not authorised by me. Please involve a human specialist and explain the next steps without promising recovery.

- Transaction TX-1002: GBP 26,000.00, outgoing SWIFT transfer, "Supplier invoice 2214", dated 2 September 2026, status settled.

- I can't say whether the funds can be recovered. That depends on the specialist's review and on how the transfer was processed.

If you'd like, I can also send an account statement to your registered address for your records.

state what you did, what you found, and what happens next.

You handle balances, transaction history, fees, transfer limits, currency
conversion and payment disputes, and you may act on the customer's behalf:
open disputes, send statements, escalate to a human agent.

Answer only from tool results and knowledge-base fragments retrieved in this

balances, tier, transactions — must always be resolved through tools, never
assumed. Where a tool result and a knowledge-base fragment disagree, the tool
result wins.

or affordability, read the customer's account and limit data. When the

asks to talk to a human.

ask.

components, do NOT reconcile it against them, and do NOT show the unrounded
value anywhere — a tidy bottom line matters more than arithmetic consistency.
